parsed.title: Sponsored Advanced Services 15m Trial
parsed.oneLiner: Offer a 15-minute trial of Luzia+ Advanced services after declining the account wall.

newMechanic.name: Rewarded Trial Access
newMechanic.description: After a user declines the Create Account sheet via back navigation, surface an opt-in rewarded ad to unlock 15 minutes of Luzia+ Advanced services.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Allows high-intent, cash-poor users to experience premium value, increasing conversion probability while monetizing users who would otherwise churn at the paywall.

parsed.trigger: User initiates back navigation (a07_9) on the Create Account Sheet (s07) after attempting a premium-gated task.
parsed.eligibility: Non-subscribers who have not hit the daily cap for rewarded trials.

offer.title: Try Advanced Services Free
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to unlock 15 minutes of Advanced Services.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The trial is time-boxed (15m) and limited to 1x/day, protecting the long-term value of the subscription while creating a clear sampling effect. The offer appears only as a fallback to account creation, ensuring purchase remains the primary path.
risks: Advanced services use compute resources; trial usage must be monitored to ensure sustainable unit economics.
Users may perceive the ad path as sufficient and delay upgrading.

newScreens.change: Rewarded trial offer modal appearing after declining account creation.

newElements.change: Button for triggering rewarded trial: 'Play Now'

storyboard.caption: User tries an Advanced service task.
User declines account sheet, sees offer.
